compatibility_notes.note: 2 panels in series (Voc 99.8V) fits MPPT range, but max input current per MPPT (13A) is close to panel Imp (13.16A) at full sun — consider single panel per string or check derating. Also close to warranty-void threshold on inverter.
Good voltage headroom, no clipping risk at 1:1 panel-to-inverter capacity ratio.
Sungrow's 15A MPPT limit provides comfortable headroom for 550W N-type strings; good match for high-output residential systems.
445W panel pairs well with GoodWe 5kW; 11-panel array (~4.9 kWp) is a common PH residential sweet spot.
Compact Trina Vertex S footprint suits limited townhouse roofs; voltage/current within Growatt MPPT limits at 2S configuration.
Value-tier panel + value-tier inverter; typical bundled quote for 3–5 kWp provincial installs.
Budget-friendly combination; verify distributor warranty support in Visayas/Mindanao before specifying.
One microinverter per Maxeon AC module; premium shaded-roof solution, rarely cost-competitive in standard PH residential quotes.
440W panel well within Deye hybrid MPPT limits; 2S string Voc ~83V with comfortable current margin.
Huawei 6kW inverter suits 550W panels, but 12.5A MPPT limit requires careful string sizing — max 1 panel per MPPT or verify Imp derating at elevated cell temps (PH noon conditions).
Deye hybrid + Deye battery is the native ecosystem pairing; BMS communication verified.
Growatt SPH + Pylontech US5000 is the most common PH hybrid retrofit pairing; CAN/RS485 communication supported.
Native Growatt ecosystem pairing; preferred for single-vendor warranty coverage.
Huawei hybrid + LUNA2000 is the certified full-stack pairing; required for extended warranty.
BYD HVS works with Deye via CAN but requires certified integration profile; verify firmware compatibility before quoting.
Growatt MIN 5000TL-X is grid-tie only; no battery input. Requires separate hybrid inverter for storage.
Premium Fronius pairing for quality-focused C&I or high-end residential; wide MPPT voltage range supports flexible string design.
Electrically compatible but cost ratio poor — Fronius premium pricing rarely justified with mid-tier LONGi panels in PH residential context.
3 kW Growatt pairs cleanly with 8×450W (~3.6 kWp) — common townhouse sizing in PH.
Deye 3 kW hybrid supports brownout backup on typical Luzon residential loads.
